otpEnrollment.setupSubtitle: Your account requires this before you can continue
otpEnrollment.idleHint: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app, in addition to your password.
otpEnrollment.scanHint: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (like Google Authenticator or Authy), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
otpEnrollment.qrAlt: QR code for two-factor authentication setup
otpEnrollment.backupCodesWarning: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app — they won't be shown again.
otpEnrollment.requiredHint: Your account requires two-factor authentication to stay enabled. Ask an account admin to turn off the requirement if you need to disable it.
